description: The command-line surface of every product: the verbs each answers, the closed list of options each verb takes, which option supplies a setting of contract/config.schema.json, what each verb writes on standard output, and the exit codes of contract/exit-codes.json each verb can end with. An option is spelled --name=value; a verb refuses with the usage code an option its list does not name, a request to edit source among them, an option given without a value, and an argument that is no option. An analyzer verb lists its options per language, the languages whose analyzers answer it. A setting option outranks every configuration document, and its provenance names the option. Diagnostics go to standard error; a report goes to the file the invocation names, never to standard output.

on, the default, puts the verdict in the exit code; off exits 0 after any complete run.
